agent_explanation: Free-flight body with high horizontal speed triggers many substeps (41-43 per step). Gravity integration over-amplifies: observed dv per step is -1.836 m/s vs expected g*dt=0.306 m/s, i.e. 6x too large. This spurious velocity gain injects kinetic energy faster than potential loss, causing total mechanical energy to grow beyond 10%+5J allowance. Small dt (0.0001) or zero gravity removes the error, confirming large-dt gravity substep bug.
